notes.title: Update 1.0.8
notes.notes:
In the new update, a lot of new things have been fixed and added:

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs in some dialogs
[*] Optimization work done (performance gain 15%)
[*] Added new objects and items to the game world
[*] Improved game graphics due to new visual effects
[*] Other minor improvements
[/list]

notes.title: The game has been released!
notes.notes:
The Pleim game is finally out!
Development has been going on for over a year and a half. ːterminalː

You can purchase the game for the first 2 weeks with a 15% discount.

Hope you enjoy this game ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Welcome to our Discord
notes.notes: We are glad to announce that our [url=https://discord.gg/sPCwmegR]Discord[/url] server has opened, where you can ask your questions in a convenient format. In the same place we will post small news about the development that will not fall into the Steam feed.

notes.title: Added dynamic weather change to the game
notes.notes:
Work on the game is in full swing and we recently added dynamic weather changes, integrated rain, fog, thunderstorms, wind, etc. into the game.

If you like our game - add it to your wishlist and you will be the first to know about the release of Pleim.

notes.title: Game development continues
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We continue to develop the game, the New Year holidays are over and we have started active development.

No release date has been set yet, but the game will definitely be released in 2022!

Happy New Year to everyone!
